study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping Neurophysiological Subtypes of Major Depressive Disorder Using Normative Models of the Functional Connectome

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to estimate the normative model of FCS. The PCNtoolkit package was used for estimation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: For each brain region, we estimated a normative model of FCS as a function of age and sex by using Gaussian process regression (20) in the HCs

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Whole-brain functional connectivity strength (FCS) values were computed for each participant based on a predefined functional parcellation (220 cerebral regions).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: we computed the whole-brain FCS values for each participant ... FCS of the brain regions were positioned on the normative percentile charts

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model of FCS was estimated as a function of age and sex. Site effects were corrected using ComBat harmonization before modeling, so Site was not a covariate in the GPR model itself.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: estimated a normative model of FCS as a function of age and sex by using Gaussian process regression (20) in the HCs
